findings.class: lane-owned defect, fixed this run with mutation tests
findings.title: node16/nodenext resolution was treated the same as bundler, always emitting --module esnext, which tsc itself refuses (TS5110) under node16/nodenext.
findings.detail: _BUNDLER_MODULES = frozenset({"bundler", "node16", "nodenext"}) collapsed three resolutions with different constraints into one branch. Measured directly against this machine's tsc 5.9.3: `--module esnext --moduleResolution bundler` raises nothing; the identical pairing under `nodenext` or `node16` raises `error TS5110: Option 'module' must be set to 'NodeNext' when option 'moduleResolution' is set to 'NodeNext'.` (and the Node16 equivalent). aspose-pdf-foss/Aspose.PDF-FOSS-for-TypeScript's own tsconfig.json declares moduleResolution: "NodeNext", so before this fix all 96 examples read BLOCKED_TOOLCHAIN with this exact TS5110 message - a configuration refusal before any example's own code was read. Fix: node16/nodenext now get `module` set to their own resolution value verbatim (new constants _NODE_PAIRED_RESOLUTIONS, _BUNDLER_RESOLUTION); bundler is unchanged.
findings.evidence: Manual tsc probe: `tsc --noEmit --module esnext --moduleResolution nodenext a.ts` -> TS5110; `--module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext` -> clean; `--module esnext --moduleResolution bundler` -> no TS5110. Mutation tests test_node_paired_resolution_gets_a_matching_module (4 params: NodeNext/Node16/nodenext/node16) and test_node_paired_flags_actually_compile (2 params, real tsc) - red before (verified by reverting the fix and re-running: 6 failures, exact TS5110 messages), green after. test_bundler_resolution_keeps_the_es_module_default guards the unaffected case.

findings.class: lane-owned defect, fixed this run with mutation tests
findings.title: A README example importing the package by its own published name (not a relative path) could never resolve: the package declares no `exports` field, which Node's self-referencing-by-name resolution requires.
findings.detail: stage_sources's own docstring names only the relative-import convention (Cells' `./aspose_cells`, 3D's `./dist/...`). All 96 of PDF-TS's examples import `@asposefoss/pdf` by name instead, exactly as a real npm consumer would after `npm install`. Node's self-reference feature (resolving a package's own name from inside its own source tree) requires an `exports` field in package.json; this manifest declares only `main`/`types`, so nodenext/node16 resolution cannot find it that way, and every example read `error TS2307: Cannot find module '@asposefoss/pdf' or its corresponding type declarations.` once F1 was fixed. Fix: stage a `node_modules/<name>` entry from the staged build output, mirroring what `npm install` actually gives a real consumer, rather than depending on a Node feature this package opted out of.
findings.evidence: Mutation tests test_the_packages_own_name_resolves_like_a_real_consumers_install (staging layout) and test_an_example_importing_the_package_by_its_own_name_type_checks (real tsc, EXECUTED) - red (TS2307) before, green after.

findings.class: lane-owned defect, fixed this run with mutation tests
findings.title: `str.lstrip("./")` strips a character set, not a prefix, so `rootDir: "."` was reduced to `""` and read as "no rootDir", skipping dist staging entirely; separately, the authoritative build mapping lives in a different file this code never read.
findings.detail: PDF-TS's tsconfig.json (used by its `typecheck` script) declares `rootDir: "."` - a real, deliberate convention (typecheck the whole tree). `".".lstrip("./")` strips the lone `.` character (lstrip treats its argument as a character set), leaving `""`, which the next line read as `root_dir` falsy and skipped `dist` staging altogether - with F1+F2 fixed, all 96 examples still failed to resolve anything because `dist/` never existed. Separately, PDF-TS's `package.json` `build` script runs `tsc -p tsconfig.build.json`, a *different* config overriding `rootDir` to `"src"` - the mapping that actually produces `dist/index.js`, which `stage_sources` never read (it only ever read tsconfig.json). Fix: `_staging_options` prefers tsconfig.build.json when it declares its own rootDir/outDir, falling back to tsconfig.json with `"."` now correctly read as "the workspace itself" (source = workspace) rather than "absent" (source = None).
findings.evidence: Mutation tests test_a_narrower_build_config_wins_over_a_whole_tree_typecheck_config (dist/index.ts present, dist/src and dist/test absent) and test_a_bare_dot_root_dir_stages_the_whole_workspace (single-config fallback) - red (no dist/index.ts staged, or staged one level too deep) before, green after. Combined with F1+F2, the real repository moved from `96 candidates; failed 96` to `96 candidates; executed 9, failed 87`, `required rows without evidence: none`.
